rule: A group is priced by the unified engine if in scope, UNLESS the walk-forward replay shows harm: >= 3 replayed contracts and unified Brier worse than production by > 0.05. Groups with < 3 replayed contracts are published (no evidence of harm). Groups whose only evidence is positive news (no settled window, no reverse seed) are not priced: one-sided likelihood (Oct 21). Exclusions are computed, never hand-picked.
